airplane.title: Prove it to yourself.
airplane.hint.ios: Swipe down from the top-right corner and tap the airplane.
airplane.hint.android: Tap the indicator to open network settings.
airplane.hint.web: Switch your device to Airplane Mode, then keep this tab open.
airplane.keepIt: Airplane Mode is still on. You can use Inborn like this forever.
airplane.stillZero: Airplane Mode is off; the counter still shows OUT 0 B.
airplane.meter.counter: Bytes counted by Android for this app since you opened this screen.
airplane.meter.ios: iOS keeps no per-app byte counter. This is what Inborn's own network layer sent; the system-level proof is Settings → Privacy & Security → App Privacy Report.
airplane.meter.web: This tab sent 0 B to us. Your browser and OS may still talk to their vendors.
proof.title: Proof
proof.sinceInstall: since install · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
proof.meter.ios: iOS keeps no per-app byte counter; OUT is what Inborn's own network layer recorded. Verify at the system level in App Privacy Report.
proof.meter.web: IN is what this tab fetched from its own origin; OUT is 0 by construction: the page never sends a request body.
proof.allowlist.none: none · the app has no internet permission
proof.allowlist.play: Google Play delivers models; Inborn never opens a socket.
proof.allowlist.models: only when you ask for a download
proof.allowlist.hf: only when you ask · then it shows in App Privacy Report, on purpose
proof.delivery.play: Play Asset Delivery · verified by Play
proof.delivery.builtin: Instant ships inside the app · nothing downloaded
proof.delivery.builtinPlay: Instant arrives as a Play asset pack · nothing downloaded by Inborn
proof.permissionState.off: off · asked only when you use it
proof.trackers.line: no analytics, crash, ads or attribution SDK
proof.build.line: built {date} · match it against the published hash
proof.log.title: Network log · this session
proof.log.note: Every request the app makes lands here: host, bytes, time.
proof.verify.title: CHECK FOR YOURSELF
proof.verify.android: Google Play → Inborn → About this app → App permissions: no "Have full network access". Or on a computer: adb shell dumpsys package com.inbornapp.mobile | grep INTERNET returns nothing.
proof.verify.ios: Settings → Privacy & Security → App Privacy Report → Inborn: no domains, unless you asked for a Hugging Face download.
proof.verify.web: Open your browser's developer tools → Network: only this page's own origin appears.
proof.verify.firewall: Put us behind Little Snitch, NetGuard or Lockdown and watch nothing appear.
lock.lockedExplainPasscode: Your passcode opens Inborn. Chats stay encrypted until then.
lock.noPasscode: No passcode was set. Turn the lock off in Settings.
lock.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left before wipe
lock.noBiometrics: No biometrics on this device: a passcode protects the app instead.
lock.hiddenWhileCaptured: HIDDEN WHILE THE SCREEN IS RECORDED
passcode.hint: 4 to 8 digits. It is never stored, only a salted hash.

wipe.title: Delete everything
wipe.explain: Deletes every chat, the encryption key and every document on this device. Nothing was ever anywhere else, so nothing can be recovered.
wipe.confirmExplain: This cannot be undone. The app restarts as if just installed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.security.hideInSwitcher.sub: Chats are blurred while Inborn is in the background.

settings.security.screenshots.ios: iOS cannot block screenshots. Inborn hides chats while the screen is recorded or mirrored.
settings.security.panicWipe: Delete everything after failed unlock attempts
settings.performance.autoPowerSub: Smaller model on low battery or heat. On for phones, off on desktop.
storage.title: Privacy & storage
storage.backup: Chats are included in your device backup, encrypted. Models are not. Delete the app and chats live nowhere else.
storage.backup.web: Chats live in this browser only. Clearing site data removes them.
storage.noSync: There is no cloud sync. Another device starts empty.
storage.deleteChats.explain: Every saved chat is deleted. Models and settings stay.
